message:
docs(update): survey the current install wiring and draft the updater design

Step 1 of the update feature: establish, with file:line evidence, how the
product is wired today -- installer payload and kill list, per-executable UAC
manifests, host/stream/capture and client/viewer process trees, directory
server routes and auth, the product HTTP client's limits, and the Android
packaging and signing state. Records the four known defects that any design
has to answer for (kill list vs payload mismatch, taskkill /T taking the
updater with it, no relaunch after install, compare_versions as a reuse
candidate) without fixing them, and drafts only the parts that do not depend
on pending decisions. Artifact provenance, Android key policy, manifest schema
and new server endpoints are left explicitly open.

Documentation only -- no product, CMake or gradle changes, no build or test run.
